# Test data sources

## `snapshots/input/*`

Written for this repository (Apache-2.0, like the rest of ScipSharp): `features` (units, program, include file, form),
`syntax` (operators, message methods, externals, nested generics, asm, goto, …) and `encodings` (a Windows-1252
"ANSI" unit with non-ASCII identifiers and a UTF-8-with-BOM unit with a Delphi 12 multi-line string and astral
characters). The expected snapshots under `snapshots/output` are generated by the indexer
(`SCIP_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 dotnet test --project tests/ScipSharp.Indexer.Delphi.Tests`) and reviewed by hand.
